risk_description: Improper wiring harness of the left rear side airbag can damage the airbag when weight is placed on the rear seat cushion. As a result, this airbag may not deploy, increasing the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
